text:
alex (EngRel): deploybot auto-paused slot for orbit-service in eu-west-1 — reason: CONTROL_PLANE_HIGH_CPU. holding the next 3 rollout slots. pinging oncall for impact

deploy-bot: DeployBot: release 2026-03-20T18:20:00Z paused (slot 42) by automatic gate; reason=CONTROL_PLANE_HIGH_CPU. canaries stopped. :warning:

maria (SRE): oncall — what's the visible impact? can we continue canaries outside eu?

josh (Oncall): seeing kube-scheduler CPU spikes in eu-west-1, autoscaler thrash. API error rate ~2%, control-plane p95 latency up ~400ms. infra digging in. ETA ~20m. recommend hold + pin the current RC to prevent accidental rollforward.

alex (EngRel): agree pin is safest. if we pin, can we still push to other regions? what's the ops policy here?

ops-bot: Policy check: cross-region rollouts permitted unless DEP_INFRA flag set. Current flags: DEP_INFRA=true for eu-west-1.

maria (SRE): with DEP_INFRA=true I'd prefer a global freeze for now to avoid cascading. Proposed plan:
1) Pin release 2026-03-20-rc4 to slot 41 (no further rollouts).
2) Abort/rollback canary in eu-west-1 only if error rate >1.5% or SLOs violated.
3) Reschedule remaining slots to next maintenance window: 2026-03-20 22:00 UTC (staggered).
4) Sam to update release notes/comms. Alex to run pin. Josh to monitor and post ETA updates.

maria (SRE): pin command (to run):
```
./relctl pin --service=orbit --version=2026-03-20-rc4 --slot=41
```

alex (EngRel): running pin now. will confirm once done. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: DeployBot: release 2026-03-20-rc4 pinned by alex (EngRel). slot 41 pinned. canary aborted in eu-west-1. watchers notified.

sam (PM): I'll draft comms to PG/CS and update the release notes. Do we want a rollback entry in the notes or just a hold?

josh (Oncall): no product rollback yet — metrics don't point to the release as root cause. sounds infra-related. If control-plane recovers within ~30m we can unpin and do a staggered requeue (non-eu first). If not, move everything to the 22:00 window and run a fresh canary after infra confirms stability.

maria (SRE): action items: @sam update release notes & page; @alex file a short release-hold log in the rollout; @josh add 15m status updates in thread. I'll set the ops flag expiry to 23:00 UTC if unresolved. :white_check_mark:

alex (EngRel): ack — filed quick note: https://redwood.internal/releases/notes/4456789123 (private).

deploy-bot: DeployBot: auto-resume scheduled at 2026-03-20T22:00:00Z unless manually overridden.

josh (Oncall): will post another status in ~15m. keeping an eye on scheduler restarts and etcd leader stability.

sam (PM): thanks all — I'll push comms and add a short blurb to the release notes about the hold + potential reschedule.

maria (SRE): thanks. tag me if anything spikes.

(END)
